build_retinanet_r18_config: build a RetinaNet config with ResNet-18 backbone, FPN neck, SGD optimizer, and COCO dataset for 1x training schedule
create_retinanet_model_config: create a model config that inherits from RetinaNet R50 FPN base and overrides backbone depth to 18
configure_retinanet_training: configure RetinaNet training with batch size 8, learning rate 0.005, SGD optimizer with momentum 0.9 and weight decay 0.0001
customize_retinanet_backbone: customize RetinaNet backbone to use pretrained ResNet-18 from torchvision with FPN neck channels [64, 128, 256, 512]
setup_retinanet_coco_detection: setup RetinaNet detection config for COCO dataset with 1x training schedule and default runtime settings
